mlflow._help: Per-deployment overrides live in ENV.client.io.sinkOverrides.mlflow. The MLflow credential does NOT belong here — declare a server proxy alias under server.secure.proxies.<proxy> with Authorization: Bearer <% MLFLOW_TOKEN %>. See README.md.
mlflow._security: proxy, baseURL, auth, experimentAllow, runAllow and artifactPathPrefix are trusted deployment config and are never resolvable from a session bundle. Mappers may shape structure only; they can never choose an endpoint or relax auth. The three allowlists bound the three destinations a mapper CAN choose: experiment, run name, artifact path.
mlflow._sessionTarget: null = ignore a session's params.ioSinks.mlflow.target (read only when io.sinks.mlflow.sessionControllable); "allowed" = honour it when present; "required" = honour it and decline every dispatch without it. Honoured only when experimentAllow is set. Trusted config only. See README §2b-ter.
mlflow._strictSessionTarget: false = a session target is bounded by experimentAllow only (run and artifact path are free inside an allowed experiment). true = additionally refuse a session run without runAllow, a session artifact without artifactPathPrefix, and {slideHash}/{backgroundId} on a dispatch that has no slide. Templates and mappers are unaffected. Trusted config only. See README §2b-ter.
